title: Eastern Chicken Wrap
description: A delicious and flavorful wrap filled with juicy chicken, crispy vegetables, and creamy sauce. Perfect for a quick and satisfying meal.

ingredients.name: leafy greens
ingredients.notes: such as lettuce, spinach, or kale

ingredients.name: wrap (gluten-free)
ingredients.notes: such as a whole wheat or gluten-free tortilla

ingredients.name: ti (thinly sliced red onion)
ingredients.notes: or substitute with thinly sliced yellow onion

ingredients.name: wet cucumber slices
ingredients.notes: or substitute with sliced bell peppers

instructions: Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
Season the chicken breast with salt, pepper, and middle eastern spices.
Grill the chicken for 5-6 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
Let the chicken rest for a few minutes before slicing it thinly.
Spread the zesty hummus on the wrap.
Add the sliced chicken, leafy greens, ti, and wet cucumber slices to the wrap.
Drizzle with additional hummus if desired.
